project.name: Paperband Chart
project.description: Renders ```chart fenced blocks as inline SVG at build time: bars, columns, dot plots, timelines, unit squares and funnels, described in a few lines of YAML. On the classpath (as a dependency of paperband-maven-plugin, say), it lets a build draw charts from the numbers in the text. Pure Java: it needs no browser, and the SVG takes its font and colours from the page's theme.
